title: House Robber II
description:
The houses from *House Robber* now stand in a **circle**, so the first and last houses are neighbors. House `i` holds `nums[i]` dollars, and robbing two adjacent houses triggers the alarm.

Return the maximum amount you can rob without robbing two adjacent houses.

examples.explanation: You cannot rob houses 1 and 3 because they are adjacent in the circle.

hints: The first and last houses cannot both be robbed.
Solve the linear problem twice: once without the first house, once without the last, and take the better answer.
